# Bundled Python runtime

`skulpt.min.js` and `skulpt-stdlib.js` were retrieved from the same upstream URLs previously loaded by PseudoPy:

- https://skulpt.org/js/skulpt.min.js
- https://skulpt.org/js/skulpt-stdlib.js

They are bundled unchanged so worker execution does not require a live CDN. Copyright/license notices embedded in the bundles are preserved. Skulpt is an implementation of Python in JavaScript, not a full CPython installation. See the upstream project at https://github.com/skulpt/skulpt.
